paper.title_en: From Instantons to AdS Boundaries: Tracing the Geometric Path from Quantum Anomalies to Massive Gravity
paper.abstract_en: This thesis studies how boundary data enter two gravitational observables: the Dirac index on gravitational instantons and conserved charges in three-dimensional New Massive Gravity. In Einstein gravity coupled to ModMax electrodynamics, we compute the index of charged Dirac fermions on Taub-NUT and Eguchi-Hanson instantons using the Atiyah-Patodi-Singer theorem, which includes the spectral asymmetry of the boundary Dirac operator. The Taub-NUT index agrees with the Maxwell result. For Eguchi-Hanson, the gauge-field contribution to the axial anomaly depends explicitly on the ModMax parameter when expressed in terms of the solution parameters. For asymptotically anti-de Sitter solutions of New Massive Gravity with Brown-Henneaux boundary conditions, a term linear in the extrinsic curvature reproduces the holographic stress tensor of the auxiliary-field formulation. At the degenerate point, relaxed boundary conditions admit an additional constrained Fefferman-Graham coefficient. A quadratic extrinsic counterterm cancels the residual power divergence. We derive the boundary Ward identity and show that the holographic and Noether-Wald charges agree for the solutions studied.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究New Massive Gravity（一种三维大质量引力理论）在Brown-Henneaux边界条件下的全息荷与边界项构造，并讨论退化点处的松弛边界条件与补偿项，属于修改引力范畴，同时涉及引力理论基础问题。摘要给出了明确的计算对象（Taub-NUT与Eguchi-Hanson瞬子上的Dirac指标、ModMax耦合下的轴矢反常）和具体结论（指标与Maxwell情形一致、规范场贡献依赖ModMax参数、全息应力张量与Noether-Wald荷一致），理论深度与方法信号较强，新论文零引用按中性处理。
decision.title_zh: 从瞬子到AdS边界：追踪从量子反常到大规模引力的几何路径
decision.abstract_zh: 本论文研究边界数据如何进入两个引力可观测量：引力瞬子上的Dirac指标以及三维新大规模引力（New Massive Gravity）中的守恒荷。在与ModMax电动力学耦合的Einstein引力中，我们利用Atiyah-Patodi-Singer定理计算Taub-NUT与Eguchi-Hanson瞬子上带电Dirac费米子的指标，该定理包含边界Dirac算符的谱不对称性。Taub-NUT的指标与Maxwell情形下的结果一致。对于Eguchi-Hanson，当用解的参数表示时，规范场对轴矢反常的贡献显式依赖于ModMax参数。对于满足Brown-Henneaux边界条件的新大规模引力渐近反de Sitter解，一个关于外曲率线性的项再现了辅助场表述的全息应力张量。在退化点处，松弛的边界条件允许一个额外的受约束Fefferman-Graham系数。一个二次外曲率抵消项消除了残余的幂次发散。我们推导了边界Ward恒等式，并表明对于所研究的解，全息荷与Noether-Wald荷一致。
